Spin-off Manga 'Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaiou wa Isekai Tensei shitemo Ikkou ni Kamawan!' Gets Anime Adaptation
An anime adaptation of Daisuke Ihara and Eiji Mutsui's Baki Gaiden: Retsu Kaiou wa Isekai Tensei shitemo Ikkou ni Kamawan! spin-off manga was announced on Monday, revealing the announcement promotional video. Animation studio TMS Entertainment is producing the anime. Ihara and Mutsui began serializing the spin-off manga in Monthly Shounen Champion magazine in November 2020. Manga 'Kono Oto Tomare!' Ends in Three Chapters
The official X account for manga creator Amyuu Sakura announced on Sunday that their Kono Oto Tomare! (Stop This Sound!) manga will end in three chapters. The countdown includes the upcoming chapter in the October 2026 issue of Jump SQ. magazine, which is scheduled to release on September 4. In the announcement, Amyu expressed deep gratitude to the readers, noting that Kono Oto Tomare! is their first serialized work. 'Medalist Movie' Reveals New Staff, Trailer, February 19 Premiere
The Medalist Special Exhibition 2026 event revealed the new staff, a second teaser visual (pictured), and special trailer for the anime sequel film adaptation of Tsurumaikada's Medalist manga on Sunday. The anime movie is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on February 19, 2027.
